name: travelling-wave-guide
description: Qualitative: the ion is carried the length of the guide. A stacked-ring guide whose drive phase ramps along its length, so the potential is a wave that travels rather than a field that oscillates in place. An ion is caught in a well and carried at the wave speed, which is the signature of the device: transit stops depending on how fast the ion was injected. The decomposition is worth noticing - however many distinct phases the structure carries it reduces to two basis solves, because a sinusoid at any phase is a fixed combination of a sine and a cosine, and 96 rings that would otherwise need 21 supplies need two.
